question: The Kudankulam Civilian Nuclear Power Plant was built by India in joint collaboration with _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Russia**__.

__
 
• The** Kudankulam Civilian Nuclear Power Plant** was **built **by **India **in joint collaboration with **Russia.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant **(or Kudankulam NPP or KKNPP) is the **largest nuclear power station in India.**
 
• It is situated in** Kudankulam** in the **Tirunelveli district** of Tamil Nadu.</strong
